item.title: Start Here
item.description:
Howdy! I’m Will, a mechanical engineering student at Texas A&M. I also spend a lot of my time on electronics and embedded systems, plus anything else where I get to design something from scratch.

This site is a portfolio and a logbook. Projects are ordered with the most substantial work at the top. Click through any of them for the full story.
